title: pms-apiGetProvider
description: pms-apiGetProvider schema from Lightspeed Restaurant K Series API

id.description: The unique identifier for the provider.

name.description: The name of the PMS provider.

apiKey.description: The API key for the PMS provider.

businessLocationId.description: The unique identifier for the business location.

endpoint.description: The endpoint of the PMS provider. This is where Lightspeed will send PMS requests.

features.description: The optional features that the PMS provider supports. See the [Integration Guide](https://api-portal.lsk.lightspeed.app/category/property-management-systems) for more details.
